citations.claim: Nvidia reported Q3 fiscal 2025 revenue of $35.1 billion, up 17% sequentially and 94% year over year, above its $32.5 billion outlook.
citations.source_text: Revenue of 35.1 billion was up 17 percent sequentially and up 94 percent year on year and well above our outlook of 32.5 billion. All market platforms posted strong sequential and year over year growth fueled by the adoption of NVIDIA Accelerated Computing and AI.

citations.claim: Nvidia said it returned $11.2 billion to shareholders in Q3 through share repurchases and cash dividends.
citations.source_text: Strong growth was driven by self-driving brands of NVIDIA orin and robust and market demand for NEVs. Global cars is rolling out its fully electric SUV built on NVIDIA orin and drive OS. Moving to the rest of the P&L, gap growth margin was 74.6% and non-gap growth margin was 75%. Down sequentially, primarily driven by a mix shift of the H100 systems to more complex and higher cost systems within data center. Sequentially, gap operating expenses and non-gap operating expenses were up 9%. Due to higher compute, infrastructure and engineering development costs for new product introductions. In Q3, we returned 11.2 billion to shareholders in the form of share repurchases and cash dividends. Let me turn to the outlook for the fourth quarter.

citations.claim: Pro Visualization revenue was $486 million in Q3 fiscal 2025, up 7% sequentially and 17% year over year.
citations.source_text: Revenue of 486 million was up 7% sequentially and 17% year on year.

citations.claim: Automotive revenue was a record $449 million in Q3 fiscal 2025, up 30% sequentially and 72% year over year.
citations.source_text: Moving to automotive, revenue was a record 449 million, up 30% sequentially and up 72% year on year.

citations.claim: Nvidia expected Gaming product supply to remain tight for the quarter and said it aimed to improve availability after the calendar year turned.

citations.claim: Nvidia expected gross margin in the low-70% range during the early Blackwell ramp and hoped to return to the mid-70% range in later quarters.
